metadata.title: Pass 3 reference table — nanoindentation crystal-plasticity twin-band arrest in the [111] Schwarz-Diamond lattice section, Eshelby-Frank-Nabarro dislocation pile-up arrest, and syncytial membrane templating of ACC precursor vesicles during larval spiculogenesis
metadata.note: Literature values below were recalled offline during the Pass 3 remediation (no network access). Every DOI and every numeric value is flagged with its provenance and should be verified online before being treated as a digitised figure/table value. Rows with provenance 'model' are modelling choices of the script, not literature values. The nanoindentation model is a reduced 2D plane-strain single-twin-family version of the 3D crystal-plasticity FEM reported by Yang et al. (2022); the spiculogenesis model is a reduced 2D stochastic vesicle-delivery / secondary-nucleation model.

governing_equations.plane_strain_fem: K u = f_p(eps_p) - K_fp u_p ;  sigma = D (eps - eps_p) ;  bilinear Q4 plane-strain elements, flat-punch displacement control u_y = -delta on |x - x_c| <= w/2, rollers at the bottom
governing_equations.twin_schmid_resolved_shear: tau_rss^(v) = sigma : m^(v),  m^(v) = sym(s^(v) (x) n^(v)),  n^(+/-) = (+/- sin theta, cos theta), s^(+/-) = (cos theta, -/+ sin theta), theta = 26.25 deg (e{01-18} pole to c-axis)
governing_equations.twin_criterion_and_exhaustion: |tau_rss| <= tau_twin ;  d gamma = sign(tau) (|tau| - tau_twin)/G ;  |gamma| <= s_twin = 0.694
governing_equations.initial_strain_iteration: u^(k+1) = K_ff^-1 ( B^T D eps_p^(k) dA - K_fp u_p ),  one LU factorisation of the elastic K per structure
governing_equations.lamella_run_length: L_lam = max over variants of the contiguous twinned run length along +/- s^(v) through each twinned element (ray marching, half-element steps)
governing_equations.depth_normalisation: delta_on = tau_twin / max_elements(tau_rss at unit depth) for the monolith; sweep delta = m * delta_on, m in {1, 2, 3, 4}; all depth-normalised outputs independent of tau_twin and E
governing_equations.eshelby_frank_nabarro_pileup: n = pi (1 - nu) L tau / (mu b) ;  sigma_head = n tau = pi (1 - nu) L tau^2 / (mu b) ;  L_strut = a_0 sqrt(3)/4 (3D) and a_0/sqrt(6) ([111] projected bond)
governing_equations.honeycomb_111_projection: diamond node positions projected along [111] form a honeycomb of projected bond length a_0/sqrt(6); one of the four tetrahedral bonds projects to a point
governing_equations.vesicle_delivery: per step: N_v vesicles at uniform random (x, y); accepted with probability p_in if inside the syncytial template cavity else p_out (templated) or p_in phi + p_out (1 - phi) everywhere (untemplated, flux-matched); accepted vesicle adds ACC in a disc of diameter d_v
governing_equations.acc_to_calcite_kinetics: secondary: dC = k_2 A on ACC pixels 4-adjacent to calcite (domain id inherited from the neighbour) ;  primary: with probability k_1 per ACC-rich pixel per step, A -> C opening a new domain ;  domain_count = 1 + (number of primary events)
governing_equations.template_fidelity: IoU = |{A + C > 1/2} AND template| / |{A + C > 1/2} OR template|

model_parameters.name: DEFAULT_NU_CALCITE
model_parameters.note: isotropic Poisson ratio used for the plane-strain reduction of trigonal calcite

model_parameters.name: DEFAULT_TAU_TWIN_MPA
model_parameters.note: effective e-twin critical resolved shear stress at the nanoindentation scale; only sets the depth scale delta_on. Geological coarse calcite e-twin CRSS is ~10 MPa (Turner et al. 1954; De Bresser & Spiers 1997) — biogenic nanoscale values are much larger and not tabulated; the model reports depth-normalised, tau-independent outputs

model_parameters.name: DEFAULT_TWIN_PLANE_ANGLE_DEG
model_parameters.source: Turner, Griggs & Heard (1954); e{01-18} twin-plane pole lies 26.25 deg from the calcite c-axis

model_parameters.name: DEFAULT_TWIN_SHEAR
model_parameters.source: calcite e-twin shear s = 0.694 (Turner et al. 1954; Barber & Wenk 1979)

model_parameters.name: DEFAULT_BURGERS_NM
model_parameters.source: De Bresser & Spiers (1997) r{10-14}<-2021> glide Burgers vector (approximate magnitude recalled offline)

model_parameters.name: DEFAULT_N_CELLS_FE
model_parameters.note: domain edge 3 a_0 = 44.4 um, element size 0.37 um, strut width ~3.0 um = ~8 elements

model_parameters.name: DEFAULT_PUNCH_HALF_WIDTH_FRAC
model_parameters.note: flat punch of width a_0/2 = 7.4 um, comparable to a Berkovich contact at ~1 um depth

model_parameters.name: DEFAULT_SPICULE_STEPS
model_parameters.note: 48 h of spiculogenesis (gastrula to pluteus, Beniash et al. 1997)

model_parameters.name: DEFAULT_VESICLE_DIAM_UM
model_parameters.source: Vidavsky et al. (2014) ACC-containing vesicles ~0.5-1.5 um in primary mesenchyme cells

model_parameters.name: DEFAULT_P_ACCEPT_OUTSIDE
model_parameters.note: membrane leakage outside the syncytial cavity

model_parameters.name: DEFAULT_K_SECONDARY
model_parameters.note: secondary-nucleation ACC->calcite conversion per step at (and behind) a crystalline front (Politi et al. 2008 mechanism)

model_parameters.name: DEFAULT_FRONT_REACH_PX
model_parameters.note: front reach 2 px = 0.74 um per 0.5 h ~ 1.5 um/h propagation of the crystalline front

model_parameters.name: DEFAULT_K_PRIMARY
model_parameters.note: wild type: primary nucleation rare so the spicule stays a single crystal

literature_reference_values.name: diamond_strut_length_3d_over_a0
literature_reference_values.source: nearest-neighbour distance of the diamond lattice a sqrt(3)/4

literature_reference_values.name: diamond_111_projected_bond_over_a0
literature_reference_values.source: projection of a (1,-1,-1)a/4 bond onto the (111) plane: a/sqrt(6)

literature_reference_values.name: twin_band_confinement_qualitative
literature_reference_values.value: twin bands / dislocations arrested at strut-pore interfaces; damage confined to the struts adjacent to the indent
literature_reference_values.source: Yang et al. (2022) Science 375:647-652, nanoindentation and micropillar compression of Protoreaster nodosus ossicles

literature_reference_values.name: naive_solid_fraction_damage_null
literature_reference_values.source: if twinned area simply scaled with the solid fraction phi of the section, lattice/monolith twin-area ratio would equal phi = 0.50

literature_reference_values.name: gibson_ashby_regular_honeycomb_in_plane_modulus
literature_reference_values.source: Gibson & Ashby (1997) Cellular Solids, regular hexagonal honeycomb in-plane modulus (thin-wall limit)

literature_reference_values.name: calcite_e_twin_crss_geological_MPa
literature_reference_values.source: Turner et al. (1954); De Bresser & Spiers (1997)

literature_reference_values.name: spicule_single_crystal_domain_count
literature_reference_values.source: Donnay & Pawson (1969) X-ray diffraction: each echinoderm ossicle/spicule diffracts as a single calcite crystal

literature_reference_values.name: acc_to_calcite_mechanism
literature_reference_values.value: secondary nucleation propagating from the crystalline centre, not random primary nucleation

literature_reference_values.name: acc_precursor_in_spicule
literature_reference_values.value: spicules deposited as ACC that transforms to calcite over ~days
literature_reference_values.source: Beniash et al. (1997) Proc R Soc B 264:461-465

literature_reference_values.name: spicule_seed_granule
literature_reference_values.value: single rhombohedral calcite granule nucleated in the syncytial cavity at ~24 h
